purpose: Test whether the existing SciX plus arXiv review can assume coverage of core software-engineering venues and prepare a publisher-native supplementary search.
discovery_source: OpenAlex public metadata, used as a coverage probe rather than a substitute for ACM DL, IEEE Xplore, or Scopus.

interpretation: A missing exact DOI in the deterministic sample demonstrates a coverage gap but does not estimate recall for all software-engineering literature. A follow-up known-set audit found all 26 TSE candidates from the probe in SciX by exact DOI; that result does not estimate topic-search recall within TSE or replace IEEE Xplore. The archival edition remains conditional on the prepared ACM, IEEE, and Scopus searches, or a justified database substitution with documented equivalence.
